Subject: Security exhibit: SOC2, pen-test window, and proposed audit language

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the demo this week. Our security team asked me to follow up with a few specifics so we can close procurement on the Lumina order form:

- Can you share the most recent SOC 2 report summary and the standard SOC 2 assertions you support?
- We need pen-test timing and whether Redwood will allow a single annual external pentest with ephemeral staging access (we prefer a defined 14-day window).
- For audit rights: we usually request a clause that permits periodic evidence requests and a one-time inspection with 30 days' notice. Can Redwood share its suggested language?
- Finally — evidence cadence: our auditors like a quarterly snapshot of controls evidence (MFA logs, change control summaries) plus a one-off bundle for the order form sign-off. Is that feasible?

Appreciate a short redline or proposal we can attach to the order form.

Best,

Erin —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a proposed redline for the security exhibit and a short SOC 2 summary (redacted). Highlights / quick answers below before you dive into the doc: 

1) SOC 2: we can provide the latest Type II summary and a SOC2 cover letter with scope notes. Full report requires an NDA; we typically gate it via our legal team.

2) Pen-test: we support a single annual third-party penetration test. We can offer a 14-day staging window for external testers with ephemeral creds; we ask for testplan alignment 10 business days in advance and scoped IP ranges.

3) Audit language: in the attached "security-exhibit-proposed-redline.docx" we propose allowing evidence requests for stated assertions and a timeboxed inspection clause (one-time per 12 months) with 30 days' written notice — we include carveouts for multi-tenant customer data and production access constraints.

4) Evidence cadence: we can commit to a quarterly evidence snapshot (non-prod artifacts + anonymized control logs) and a single order-form bundle on signature. We'll call out which artifacts are operational (logs, MFA summaries) vs contractual (SOC2 report).

Next steps I propose: legal + security redline sync this Wednesday, Ben + Laura + Priyo on our side. If Lumina wants to accept our proposed language, we can add the exhibit to the order form draft (I attached a clean PDF of the orderform).

Attaching: security-exhibit-proposed-redline.docx (docx), SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (pdf), orderform-draft-HS-4992.pdf (pdf).

Laura —

Drafted ops note below (summary we can give to Lumina):

- Quarterly snapshot contents (redwood-provided): SOC2 summary cover letter (redacted), MFA enforcement summary (count of MFA-enabled users by role), change-control digest (list of deploy windows and PR references for the quarter), and anonymized alerting volume by category.
- Retention: snapshots reflect 90-day retention for control logs; raw access logs are never provided.
- Pen-test staging: we will provide a sandbox environment with ephemeral creds; external testers get access only to the sandbox, not production. Staging will be available for a 14-day window; we require a test plan and rules of engagement signed 7 business days prior.
- Evidence delivery: quarterly snapshots delivered via secure Drive link + a short verification checklist. For order-form sign-off, we produce a single evidence bundle (PDF + CSV manifests).

I recommend adding a short sentence in the exhibit: "Evidence requests shall be limited to the artifacts specified in Appendix A and delivered under Redwood's evidence-handling procedures."

Happy to draft Appendix A if legal wants it.
